elements.requirement: Subsections (2) to (8) of section 4A apply if a court in Scotland or Northern Ireland is considering the seriousness of an offence under section 4(3) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 and the offender had attained the age of 18 at the time the offence was committed.
elements.quote: a court in Scotland or Northern Ireland is considering the seriousness of an offence under section 4(3) of this Act, and (b) at the time the offence was committed the offender had attained the age of 18

elements.requirement: A court in Scotland or Northern Ireland considering the seriousness of an offence under section 4(3) must treat the fact that either the first condition or the second condition is met as an aggravating factor that increases the seriousness of the offence.
elements.quote: must treat the fact that the condition is met as an aggravating factor (that is to say, a factor that increases the seriousness of the offence)

elements.requirement: A court in Scotland or Northern Ireland considering the seriousness of an offence under section 4(3) must state in open court that the offence is aggravated if either the first condition or the second condition is met.
elements.quote: must state in open court that the offence is so aggravated

elements.requirement: The first condition is met if the offence under section 4(3) was committed on or in the vicinity of school premises at a relevant time.
elements.quote: The first condition is that the offence was committed on or in the vicinity of school premises at a relevant time

elements.requirement: The second condition is met if, in connection with the commission of the offence under section 4(3), the offender used a courier who was under the age of 18 at the time the offence was committed.
elements.quote: The second condition is that in connection with the commission of the offence the offender used a courier who, at the time the offence was committed, was under the age of 18

elements.requirement: A relevant time includes any time when the school premises are in use by persons under the age of 18.
elements.quote: any time when the school premises are in use by persons under the age of 18

elements.requirement: A relevant time includes one hour before the start and one hour after the end of any time when the school premises are in use by persons under the age of 18.
elements.quote: one hour before the start and one hour after the end of any such time

elements.requirement: An offender uses a courier in connection with an offence under section 4(3) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 if the offender causes or permits another person acting as courier to deliver a controlled drug to a third person.
elements.quote: he causes or permits another person (the courier)— (a) to deliver a controlled drug to a third person

elements.requirement: An offender uses a courier in connection with an offence under section 4(3) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 if the offender causes or permits another person acting as courier to deliver a drug related consideration to the offender or to a third person.
elements.quote: to deliver a drug related consideration to himself or a third person

elements.requirement: A drug related consideration includes a consideration of any description which is obtained in connection with the supply of a controlled drug.
elements.quote: is obtained in connection with the supply of a controlled drug

elements.requirement: A drug related consideration includes a consideration of any description which is intended to be used in connection with obtaining a controlled drug.
elements.quote: is intended to be used in connection with obtaining a controlled drug

elements.requirement: School premises means land used for the purposes of a school, excluding any land occupied solely as a dwelling by a person employed at the school.
elements.quote: “school premises” means land used for the purposes of a school excluding any land occupied solely as a dwelling by a person employed at the school

elements.requirement: In England and Wales, school has the same meaning as in section 4 of the Education Act 1996.
elements.quote: in England and Wales, as in section 4 of the Education Act 1996

elements.requirement: In Scotland, school has the same meaning as in section 135(1) of the Education (Scotland) Act 1980.
elements.quote: in Scotland, as in section 135(1) of the Education (Scotland) Act 1980

elements.requirement: In Northern Ireland, school has the same meaning as in Article 2(2) of the Education and Libraries (Northern Ireland) Order 1986.
elements.quote: in Northern Ireland, as in Article 2(2) of the Education and Libraries (Northern Ireland) Order 1986
